summary: @or-sdk/library-types-v2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is variable-obfuscated (identifiers of the form `_0xNNNN`), detects platform/architecture (including Alpine musl), downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~700 KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using obfuscator.io-style transforms: a large mixed numeric/string constant array with a rotating shuffler and char-code reconstruction via `String.fromCodePoint`, plus machine-generated identifiers. The obfuscated payload is executed by the freshly downloaded alien runtime, bypassing Node-based scanners. The package advertises itself as SDK type definitions and has no legitimate need to pull a second language runtime at install time. The `files` allowlist in package.json (`./dist/browser`, `./dist/nest`, `CHANGELOG.md`) does not list `setup.mjs` or `math_init.js`, yet both ship at the tarball root — consistent with a payload added outside the normal publish flow.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
